question: The ratio of the volume of two cylinders is 27 ∶ 25 and the ratio of their heights is 3 ∶ 4. If the area of the base of the second cylinder is 3850 cm², then what will be the radius of the first cylinder?
solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the volume of the two cylinders = 27 : 25

The ratio of the heights of the cylinders = 3 : 4

The area of the base of the second cylinder = 3850 cm²

**Formula used:**

A = π × r² Where, A = Area of the base of the cylinder, and h = Height of the cylinder

V = π × r² × h Where, V = Volume of the cylinder, r = Radius of the cylinder, and h = Height of the cylinder

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the first cylinder be R and second cylinder be r volume of the first cylinder be 27v and second cylinder be 25v and height of the first cylinder be 3x and height of the second cylinder be 4x

According to the question

⇒ 27v = π × (3x) × R² ---(1)

⇒ 3850 = π × r² 

⇒ 3850 = {22over 7}× r²

⇒ 175 × 7 = r²

⇒ r = √1225 = 35 cm

The volume of the second cylinder = 25v

⇒ 3850 × (4x) = 25v

⇒ 154 × (4x) = v

⇒ v = 616x

The volume of the first cylinder = 27v = 27 × (616x) = 

⇒ 27 × (616x) = {22over7}× R²× 3x 

⇒ 27 × 28 × 7 = 3 × R²

⇒ 9 × 28 × 7 = R²

⇒ 1764 = R²

⇒ R = √1764 = 42

**∴ The required result will be 42.**
